algorithm: Full private copies capture the exact iterator length once. Name/value bytes and work/control checks precede each existing incremental hinted push; terminal checking is retained.
Filtered copies use the input label count as an upper bound, visiting each reached predicate once without eager reservation or a counting pass.
Only the two local mutable append sites use the next ordinary power-of-two capacity, minimum4, when full. Compact3/9/17 arrays grow4/16/32. Existing larger capacity and untracked fallback remain.
No copy, ownership transfer, control charge, swap or error phase moves. Shared AccountedVec growth remains unchanged.
